entries.name: OAAB Data
entries.description: Of Ash and Blight, an asset repository expanding a standardized set of resources for use with Morrowind and specifically Vvardenfell environments and locations. Some overlap with Tamriel Data.

entries.name: Tamriel Data
entries.description: Asset repository featuring a standardized set of resources for use across the Tamriel Rebuilt and Project Tamriel provinces. Some overlap with OAAB Data

entries.name: AATL Data
entries.description: An Addendum to Tamrielic Lore is an asset repository focusing on artifacts, weapons, armor, books, and other miscellaneous assets that modders can use in their mods.

entries.name: Sound Data
entries.description: Asset repository featuring a number of new sound effects and music tracks, already setup with in-game activators, ready to be used to add additional atmospheric and ambient tracks to various locations.

entries.name: Outlander Asset Library
entries.description: Technically not an asset repository, the Oulander Asset Library is still a free collection of assets that modders can use in their own mods, provided they add a link to the library's archive on Patreon in their documentation and Read Me files. Note, some assets might be a bit buggy, but there's still some useful resources here.

entries.name: Morrowind Modding Wiki
entries.description: The Morrowind Modding Wiki is home to a variety of tutorials, modding guides, and lists of utilities and tools.

entries.name: Morrowind on Nexus Mods
entries.description: The main hosting platform for Morrowind mods.

entries.name: OpenMW Website
entries.description: The official website for the game engine replacement OpenMW, featuring the latest developments and releases.

entries.name: OpenMW Modding
entries.description: A website dedicated to OpenMW mods, hosting a variety of automated mod lists using UMO.

entries.name: Danae's Website
entries.description: Danae's personal website, featuring a number of community links, Morrowind mod lists, and articles written by both Danae and AliceL93.

entries.name: Emma's Morrowind Site
entries.description: The historic home of Emma's Morrowind Mods, also hosting the mods of other authors like Grumpy and Kateri. The official home of Julan - Ashlander Companion.

entries.name: AliceL93's Website
entries.description: AliceL93's personal website, featuring community links, her Morrowind mods, and fan fiction.

entries.name: Abot's Website
entries.description: Abot's Morrowind Website, featuring a number of hosted mods and mod lists, including a list of Morrowind mods from Morrowind Modding History with WaybackMachine download links.

entries.name: OAAB Data Website
entries.description: The official website of OAAB Data, featuring an asset browser, wiki, and CSSE interop functionality, allowing you to drop assets from the website directly into your mod in the Construction Set.

entries.name: Tamriel Rebuilt Website
entries.description: The official website of Morrowind's largest flagship project and province mod. In development since 2001.

entries.name: Project Tamriel Website
entries.description: The home of the other province mods, including Skyrim - Home of the Nords, Province: Cyrodiil, High Rock 3E 427, and Project Hammerfell.

entries.name: UESP
entries.description: The biggest Elder Scrolls-based wiki, featuring articles on all of Morrowind's locations, quests, console commands, and more.

entries.name: The Imperial Library
entries.description: An archive of books, literature, notes, and other documents from The Elder Scrolls games.

entries.name: Project Tamriel Wiki
entries.description: The official wiki for Project Tamriel, featuring articles on lore, provinces, active developments, and tutorials.

entries.name: Lyithdonea Wiki
entries.description: The official wiki of Lyithdonea - The Azurian Isles, featuring lore and general information about Melchior's province-sized project.

entries.name: Confrerie-des-Traducteurs
entries.description: French translations of English Morrowind mods.

entries.name: Alice's Morrowind Fan Fiction
entries.description: A collection of AliceL93's fan fiction on AO3.

entries.name: OAAB Data Patreon
entries.description: The official patreon of OAAB Data. Supporting them means supporting the community's modders! All funds go into acquiring better tools for asset creation and development.

entries.name: RubberMan's Morrowind Modding Blog
entries.description: RubberMan's personal website, featuring mod lists, articles, and Morrowind modding tutorials.

entries.name: The Morrowind 20th Anniversary Booklet
entries.description: A downloadable book of Morrowind memories, experiences, and artwork, released in 2022 for Morrowind's 20th anniversary.

entries.name: Morrowind Modding Community Discord Server
entries.description: One of the central hubs of the modding community and also the place where Modjam, Modathon, and Madness announcements are typically made.

entries.name: Tamriel Rebuilt Discord Server
entries.description: The official Discord server for Morrowind's longest running mod project.

entries.name: Project Tamriel Discord Server
entries.description: Official Project Tamriel server, features development channels for all currently active Project Tamriel mods.

entries.name: OpenMW Discord Server
entries.description: Official server for OpenMW and also includes extensive channels for active mod developments, showcases, and new mod releases.

entries.name: Melchior Dahrk's Discord Server
entries.description: Home of OAAB, Lyithdonea, and other modding projects.

entries.name: Nexus Mods
entries.description: The official Nexus Mods Discord server. Primarily focused on the platform as a whole, but there is a Morrowind channel as well.

entries.name: TES3MP Discord Server
entries.description: The home of Morrowind's Multiplayer Engine.

entries.name: Danae's Discord Server
entries.description: Danae's personal Discord Server, featuring her videos, chats, and various community announcements.

entries.name: The Morrowind Writers Guild Discord Server
entries.description: AliceL93's server and the home of the annual Morrowind Writing Competition.

entries.name: Morrowind Rebirth Discord Server
entries.description: The official Discord server of Morrowind Rebirth, featuring development updates, bug reports, and community feedback channels.

entries.name: Morrowind Animation Overhaul Project Discord Server
entries.description: A server dedicated to replacing and overhauling Morrowind's dated animations.

entries.name: Tamriel Rebuilt's YouTube Channel
entries.description: The official Tamriel Rebuilt channel, featuring trailers and promotions for upcoming releases.

entries.name: MrOpenMW
entries.description: The official YouTube channel of the OpenMW project, featuring major announcements, updates, and development releases.

entries.name: DanaePlays
entries.description: Danae's Personal YouTube Channel, featuring Morrowind Let's Plays, livestreams, modding tutorials, interviews and podcasts.

entries.name: Micky D's YouTube Channel
entries.description: Micky D features a number of Morrowind mods, some more in-depth showcases, as well as highlighting some of Morrowind's more obscure or eccentric mods from the past couple of decades.

entries.name: Zaric Zhakaron
entries.description: Tons of Morrowind, Daggerfall, and other videos focused on the Elder Scrolls series, including livestreams.

entries.name: Warlockracy
entries.description: Video essays and long-form narrative reviews, including coverage of Morrowind's province mods (Tamriel Rebuilt, Province: Cyrodiil, and Skyrim - Home of the Nords).

entries.name: Magicka Addict
entries.description: A YouTube channel dedicated to Elder Scrolls modding, featuring mod showcases, Tamriel Rebuilt dev logs and interviews, lore videos, and more.

entries.name: Gitshiver
entries.description: A channel dedicated to Morrowind tips, tricks, lore and gameplay.

entries.name: Professor Boondoggle
entries.description: Primarily Let's Plays, including videos on Morrowind, Fallout New Vegas, and other older titles. Also has the occasional mod showcase video!

entries.name: Tamrielle
entries.description: Elder Scrolls YouTuber that occasionally features Morrowind content.

entries.name: Demanufacturer's YouTube Channel
entries.description: The personal YouTube channel of Morrowind modder Demanufacturer87, featuring mod showcases, let's plays, and cinematic presentations of a modded OpenMW game world.

entries.name: Nobured Videos
entries.description: The YouTube channel of Morrowind modder Vegetto, featuring a number of scenic atmospheric and cinematic videos of modded Morrowind.

entries.name: Max Yari's YouTube Channel
entries.description: The personal YouTube channel of Max Yari, featuring videos and demonstrations of upcoming OpenMW mods.

entries.name: Abot - A Bit of Taste
entries.description: The personal YouTube channel of Abot, featuring a number of Morrowind videos, including a long-running Let's Play series.

entries.name: Melchior Dahrk's YouTube Channel
entries.description: The personal YouTube channel of Melchior Dahrk, featuring mod demo videos for a variety of Melchior's modding projects.

entries.name: GlitterGear's YouTube Channel
entries.description: The channel of Morrowind modder GlitterGear, primarily dedicated to Morrowind modding tutorials and mod announcement videos.

entries.name: Scipio's YouTube Channel
entries.description: The channel for Morrowind modder Scipio, featuring new Morrowind soundtracks and music.

entries.name: Morrowind Scripting for Dummies
entries.description: An extensive guide to vanilla Morrowind's native scripting language, featuring a list of functions, example scripts, and more.

entries.name: Morrowind Dialogue for Dummies
entries.description: A 72-page PDF that explains Morrowind's dialogue editor, how it works, examples, and basic quest implementation. Probably the most thorough documentation of the CS dialogue window available for Morrowind.

entries.name: CSSE Documentation
entries.description: A list of changes, features, and new shortcuts for the CSSE (Construction Set Script Extender)

entries.name: Quick CS Interior Tutorial (Project Tamriel Wiki)
MWSE Lua Modding Tutorial - Crafting Basics
entries.description: A tutorial with an introductory guide to MWSE lua that provides examples of how to implement craftable items using The Crafting Framework and Skills Module.

entries.name: Lost Tomb - Modders Resource for Scripted Battles (MWScript)
entries.description: An example plugin file demonstrating how to script complicated boss battles using only the vanilla game engine and remaining compatible with OpenMW.

entries.name: Morrowind Modding Wiki - Tools Page
entries.description: A nearly comprehensive list of different modding tools for Morrowind, covering everything from basic external editors to name generators, mod cleaning, 3d models, and generating animated grass.

entries.name: Teo's Online Construction Set
entries.description: A web-based editor and workspace for designing quests.

entries.name: TES3CONV
entries.description: A tool for converting Morrowind ESP files into JSON files and vice-versa.

entries.name: Merge to Master
entries.description: A tool for merging ESP files into a required ESM (master) file

entries.name: TESFaithSharp Plus
entries.description: A utility for moving, duplicating, and removing landmasses from .esp and .esm files. Typically used to make compatibility patches between landmass mods.

entries.name: Morrowind Voice Generator
entries.description: A utility for generating mass voice files for a specific or large number of mods at once, with the ability to tag particular emotions to particular lines. Requires additional frameworks and/or voice tools for actual implementation.

entries.name: PNG - DDS Texture Converter
entries.description: A utility for converting textures to and from PNG and DDS formats.

entries.name: TES3ZEROEDIT
entries.description: A browser-based editor for editing mod records.

entries.name: NIFZEROEDIT
entries.description: A browser-based NIF editor

entries.name: Kezyma's Map Builder for Morrowind
entries.description: A tool to generate html-based maps of current load orders or specific mods.

entries.name: Export Sphere Script
entries.description: A MWSE tool that allows the spawning and scaling of an in-game sphere that can capture anything inside it and export it into Blender.

entries.name: Yet Another Morrowind Plugin Tools
entries.description: A suite of utilities that includes programs for mod conflict detection, translation support, and batch edit operations.

entries.name: UESP Script Function List
entries.description: A list of MWscript functions.

entries.name: Vvardenfell Flora Location Guide
entries.description: A gallery showing the common regions for certain varieties of flora in Morrowind.

entries.name: Morrowind Modding Community Asset List
entries.description: A document of open-permissions assets that other modders can use in their mods.

entries.name: Morrowind Visual Index
entries.description: A gallery of screenshots of CS objects and references

entries.name: Skills Module
entries.description: Allows creation and addition of new skills in MWSE

entries.name: Magicka Expanded
entries.description: Allows for the creation of new spells and spell effects in MWSE

entries.name: The Crafting Framework
entries.description: Allows for new crafting mechanics to be defined and added to the game in MWSE

entries.name: Onion - Layered Accessories
entries.description: Framework for adding additional armor and clothing slots to be used in-game in MWSE

entries.name: MWSE Perk Framework
entries.description: Framework for adding functional perks to the game in MWSE

entries.name: The Achievement Framework
entries.description: Allows for defining conditions and enabling in-game achievements, complete with new UI features, in MWSE.

entries.name: Tatau - The Tattoo Framework
entries.description: Framework for adding body modification options in-game with MWSE

entries.name: Bazaar - The Trading Framework
entries.description: Framework for adding and defining new currencies and bartering options in MWSE

entries.name: Smith - The Weapon Crafting Framework
entries.description: Framework for breaking weapons down into parts and re-combining them into new weapons in MWSE

entries.name: Beware the Night
entries.description: Resource for creating unique day and night-time leveled lists for exterior cells in MWSE.

entries.name: Merlord's Character Backgrounds
entries.description: Expands the CharGen process with new character background options. Can be used as a framework to add additional background presets for MWSE.

entries.name: MWSE Dynamic Object Replacer
entries.description: Framework for replacing objects at runtime for MWSE.

entries.name: FluadHTN - The AI Framework (formerly OdaiHTN)
entries.description: Framework for setting up AI behaviors. Works for both MWSE and OpenMW

entries.name: Set Bonus
entries.description: Framework that adds bonuses for matching sets, with modder resource interop support for other mods to define their own sets for both MWSE and OpenMW

entries.name: Quick Select Menu
entries.description: A Framework for designing quick select menus for your own mods using MWSE

entries.name: MUSE 2 - Morrowind Music System Extended
entries.description: Framework for defining location or region based playlists or soundtracks using MWSE

entries.name: HeartStrings
entries.description: Music Framework with modder features for defining location and region based playlists or soundtracks (similar to MUSE) for MWSE

entries.name: Dynamic Conversations (MWSE)
entries.description: A framework to add procedural voiced and/or text conversations to random NPCs in set locations, or specific NPCs at different times of day or weather conditions, with animation support for MWSE.

entries.name: Kezyma's Voices of Vvardenfell
entries.description: A framework to add voiced dialogue to in-game dialogue text boxes, works for both MWSE and OpenMW.

entries.name: OMW Achievements
entries.description: OpenMW conversion of the MWSE Achievement Framework, allowing modders to enable, define, and set new in-game achievements for players to unlock with OpenMW

entries.name: (OpenMW) Crafting Framework
entries.description: Allows for the creation of new crafting mechanics in OpenMW with mod-support for defining new recipes for craftable items

entries.name: Stats Window Extender (OpenMW)
entries.description: Framework and API that allows modders to extend the UI and Stats Window with new sections and display new information with OpenMW

entries.name: Skill Framework (OpenMW)
entries.description: Framework that allows modders to define and add new types of skills to the game using OpenMW

entries.name: S3maphore - OpenMW Music Management from the Future
entries.description: Framework for defining custom music playlists for set times or locations for OpenMW

entries.name: Character Traits Framework (OpenMW)
entries.description: A Framework based on Merlord's Character Backgrounds that allows modders to define new character generation elements for OpenMW

entries.name: SPELL FRAMEWORK PLUS (OpenMW)
entries.description: A framework for adding custom spell effects to the game using OpenMW lua

entries.name: Perk Framework (OpenMW)
entries.description: A framework for adding new perks to the game for OpenMW.

entries.name: Dynamic NPC Framework (Procedural Chatter)
entries.description: A framework for adding new procedural voiced and/or text conversations between NPCs, as well as NPC scheduling, companionships, and animations for OpenMW.

entries.name: Magic Window Extender (OpenMW)
entries.description: Includes support for added spell effects and icons in the Magic window of the UI.

entries.name: FlexTag - The Tagging Framework That HOLDS
entries.description: A framework for querying and adding tags, useful for lua mods.
